reviewSamples.author: Photo of TETIANA NERA
reviewSamples.text:
I really like this place and highly recommend it! The customer service is excellent. They always respond to all my questions quickly, try to understand my situation, and do their best to accommodate me and schedule appointments at times that are convenient for me.

The place is extremely clean, with a pleasant and welcoming atmosphere. Everyone is professional, attentive, and helpful. I’m very happy with my experience here!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of jayrielisse
reviewSamples.text: Alana is a great injector ! I’ve been 3 times to get my lips done and have brought friends with me 4 times since and everyone is always happy. The receptionist is also very helpful.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Martyna Fyda
reviewSamples.text: Exceptional service! They’re always accommodating and offer a wide range of treatment options using the latest technology. I’ve had a great experience every time and keep coming back. Highly recommend!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of dime a
reviewSamples.text: Got my lips done here by Alana and it was a great experience! She was very accommodating to numbing me up again due to being nervous and was updating me throughout the whole process. I get very faint/anxious with needles and apparently my boyfriend does too..they were super accommodating to him as well when he couldn’t handle watching it and almost passed out 😂! She achieved the exact look I wanted (more of an upper top lip)  I’m so happy I came here and you can’t beat the prices here too!! I also had a rhinoplasty done about 7-8 weeks ago to coming here and all I did was submit an approval letter from my surgeon with no issues!❤️ Thank you.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Autumn Ansestt
reviewSamples.text: The receptionist was very welcoming and professional, and Alana was absolutely amazing! She was so funny and made me feel comfortable the entire time. I was very relaxed that I hardly felt a thing! My lips turned out absolutely beautiful, and I couldn’t be happier with my results. I definitely recommend Alana to anyone considering lip filler. Needless to say, she’s stuck with me forever!
